subject: re-st
title: RE.ST.------PRIN.INFO.
description: Diagram in CMBA-19, embedded in Braxton's argument about Coltrane's late-fifties activity and the move into source-transfer extension via modal forms. (C)RE-ST (restructuralism) is crossed with PRI-INFO (principle information): the question is what restructuralism does to principle information in a context where modal forms are reorganizing what counts as primary informational ground. RE-ST branches to INT (intention), which carries UNF-PI (unification positively intended/world unification) and CN-INFO (controlled information) → AF-COMP (affinity compression). RE-ST also branches to SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), which carries IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism) → INTR (interpretation), and CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) → MT-INFO (multi-information) → a second AF-COMP.
